critical_code_review_comments: ImplantScanSheet still calls Alert.alert in a few places (line 126 'Code read', line 138 'Camera blocked', line 163 'Upload failed'). Per agent-note Alert.alert does not render on RN-web; on web those cases will silently no-op. Non-blocking for this iteration because the happy paths use inline warnings, but worth converting to inline messaging for web parity in a follow-up.

GtinMapIn.system/label allow empty string but are typed Optional[str]; POST /api/gtin normalises label to 'brand system' fallback which is fine. Consider indexing db.gtin_map.gtin_key for uniqueness — current upsert uses {gtin_key: key} filter but there is no explicit index (schema-level), so under heavy load duplicate upserts could race.

The PDF traceability line uses fpdf multi_cell which wraps long value strings — the resulting text extraction can insert line breaks between label and value (e.g. 'Source:' \n 'Scanned'). Regex-tolerant test used. Not a functional issue but worth noting for downstream consumers that grep the PDF.
